svg.title: Two directions of metabolism
svg.desc: On the left, a large chain of linked beads labelled Large molecules (starch, protein, fat). On the right, a scatter of single beads labelled Small molecules (glucose, amino acids). A thick green arrow runs from right to left across the top, labelled Anabolism: building up, with a yellow lightning bolt going into it labelled Uses energy; under it are a maize leaf in sunlight and a growing calf. A thick red arrow runs from left to right across the bottom, labelled Catabolism: breaking down, with a yellow lightning bolt coming out of it labelled Releases energy (respiration); under it are a footballer running and a plate of nshima.
